skill.efn.scythe_skill.tooltip: Blood Power 0-1000: Harvest, Scarlet End, and Sheath Mode
skill.efn.scythe_skill.tooltip1: Normal attacks 1/3/5 stack Curse of Blood on enemies (or Blood Blessing on you if the enemy is immune).
skill.efn.scythe_skill.tooltip2: Dash / Air Slash / Harvest convert one blood stack into Damage Reduction / Attack Speed / Attack Damage buffs.
skill.efn.scythe_skill.tooltip3: Hits and parries charge Blood Power. At 100% hold guard and press the skill key: Scarlet End.
skill.efn.scythe_skill.tooltip4: Hold the use key while pressing the skill key to sheathe. Sheathed: faster movement, cheaper dodge, blood heals you.
skill.efn.scythe_skill.tooltip5: Harvest deals only 25% damage unless a blood stack is present.
skill.efn.scythe_skill.tooltip6: Damage Reduction prevents stun while you are attacking.
